title_sq: Ne Myslym Shyr, Shitet Ambient Komercial Buze Rruges Kryesore!!
description_sq: Ne Myslym Shyr, buze rruges kryesore shitet ambjent komercial, aktualisht i dhene me qera per Bar. Ambjenti ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje pallati buze rruges kryesore. Ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 165 m2, eshte i organizuar ne nje ambjent te brendshem,nje verande, 2 tualete, disponon gjithashtu dhe nje ambjent depo i cili sherben per ruajtjen e furnizimeve dhe materialeve te ndryshme. E gjithe siperfaqa edhe ajo e verandes disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. Ne dhjetor ne vitit 2018, nga qiramarresi aktual eshte bere nje investim prej 100.000 euro-sh.
title_en: In Myslym Shyr, commercial space for sale on the edge of the main street!!
description_en: In Myslym Shyr, on the edge of the main road, commercial premises are for sale, currently rented for Bar. The premises are located on the 0th floor of a building by the main road. It has a total area of ​​165 m2, it is organized in an internal area, a veranda, 2 toilets, it also has a storage area which serves to store supplies and various materials. The entire surface, including the veranda, has regular mortgage documentation. In December 2018, an investment of 100,000 euros was made by the current tenant.
